author: GitHub
description:
How do you support tens of millions of users without collecting a single piece of user telemetry? In this OpenClaw roundtable clip, Peter Steinberger shares why OpenClaw refuses to build telemetry into its open-source software. Instead of tracking user behavior directly on developer machines, the team deploys crawlers across Discord, X, and GitHub to detect emerging bugs and feature requests.
